newsitem.title: USA: FPL Group Q1 helped by lower utility costs.
newsitem.headline: FPL Group Q1 helped by lower utility costs.

text.p: FPL Group Inc Thursday reported first quarter profits of $101 million compared to $94 million a year earlier.
"Earnings rose primarily because of continuing efforts to reduce costs at Florida Power & Light Co," said FPL Group chief executive James L. Broadhead.
"Energy sales were down slightly compared to the prior period, when record demand for electricity occurred in January and February."
Despite lower sales, first quarter revenues increased to $1.45 billion from $1.36 billion, reflecting the recovery of higher costs for fuel used to generate electricity.
